## Checklist

- [ ] Commit titles follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Backend behavior changes include tests, and the affected suite passes.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- [ ] User-facing docs and any affected specification are updated.
- [ ] The diff contains no unrelated files, generated assets, or reformatting.
